hypervisor_host.description: Hostname or IP address of the KVM/libvirt hypervisor where the VM to be fenced resides.

login_username.description: SSH or libvirt username for authentication to the hypervisor.

login_password.description: SSH/libvirt password (only use if SSH keys are unavailable — insecure). Leave empty to use key-based auth.

ssh_key_file.description: Path to the SSH private key used to authenticate to the hypervisor. Must be readable by the fence agent.

operation_timeout.description: Maximum time (seconds) to wait for a single fence operation (e.g., VM power status check) before timing out.

retry_count.description: Number of times to retry a failed fence operation.

retry_delay.description: Seconds to wait between retry attempts.

vms.description: List of VMs (guests) this fence agent instance controls. Each item maps a logical fence device name to a guest identifier.

guest_name.description: Name or UUID of the VM (as known to libvirt) to fence.

tls_verify.description: Whether to verify TLS certificates when connecting via qemu+tls://. Set to 0 to disable (not recommended).

use_tls.description: If true, use TLS-encrypted libvirt connection (qemu+tls://) instead of SSH (qemu+ssh://). Requires valid TLS setup.

libvirt_uri.description: Full libvirt URI to override default connection logic (e.g., 'qemu+ssh://admin@hypervisor.example.com/system'). If set, host/port/use_tls are ignored.

subsystem.description: Libvirt subsystem to connect to (usually 'system' for system-wide libvirtd).
